evidence.other_unique_wording: The complete endpoint block also calls the requested medium ID and the strain culture-collection number unique. Those identify entities, not distinct response-row occurrences.
evidence.scope_of_absence_search: The full retained GetMediumStrains endpoint block was inspected. The supporting filesystem search included hidden and ignored evidence files. No assertion is made about unretrieved private implementation code.
evidence.actual_control_interpretation: Retained REST controls use the same native strain8/BacDive683/DSM9 entity for medium220 andJ22. Together with the documented definition, this distinguishes strain identity from a growth-observation identifier.

assessment: A unique identifier for a strain does not imply that the source list contains at most one occurrence of that identifier. The new duplicate-ID rejection adds an unsupported constraint and can reject repeated native observations, including distinct polarity/context rows. The source list and explicit envelope count should be preserved without deduplication or invented IDs.
minimal_repair: Remove only the len(unique strain IDs)==len(data) acceptance condition. Preserve strict native ID shape, exact count/list length, raw body identity, ordered list contents and all occurrences. Keep the same native ID on synthetic repeated observations; do not renumber to satisfy the invalid restriction.
regression_expectation: A strict HTTP200 list containing repeated native IDs, including an exact duplicate and positive/negative native observations, remains nonempty and survives generation/native replay unchanged. Invalid IDs, inconsistent counts and malformed envelopes still fail.
current_generation_effect: Root reports all6056 baseline successful endpoints already satisfy the removed uniqueness constraint. The independently audited seed/canary/batch source bodies and original execution-code hashes remain immutable. Corrected-code reclassification should bind the exact same retained bodies without new HTTP or restamping historical receipts.
